inbox_wxml:
<view class="chat-inbox">
  <view class="chat-page-toolbar inbox-toolbar">
    <view class="chat-toolbar-copy">
      <view class="chat-toolbar-title">{{chatFilter === 'later' ? '稍后处理' : (chatFilter === 'ended' ? '已结束会话' : '全部会话')}}</view>
      <view wx:if="{{chatRole !== 'all'}}" class="chat-toolbar-sub">{{chatRole === 'customer' ? '我的下单' : (chatRole === 'worker' ? '我的接单' : '平台协作')}}</view>
    </view>
    <button class="chat-icon-button chat-menu-trigger" bindtap="inboxMenu" aria-label="{{showInboxMenu ? '收起消息菜单' : '消息设置与筛选'}}" aria-expanded="{{showInboxMenu}}"><text class="chat-icon chat-icon-tune" aria-hidden="true"></text></button>
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{showInboxMenu}}" class="chat-operation-mask" catchtap="closeInboxMenu" catchtouchmove="stopMenuTouch">
    <view class="chat-operation-panel inbox-operation-panel" catchtap="stopMenuTouch" aria-label="消息菜单">
      <view wx:if="{{chatEnabled && isLoggedIn}}" class="chat-operation-group">
        <view class="chat-operation-label">会话状态</view>
        <view class="chat-operation-grid">
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatFilter === 'all' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="filter_all" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>全部消息</text><text>当前会话</text></button>
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatFilter === 'later' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="filter_later" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>稍后处理</text><text>待回看</text></button>
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatFilter === 'ended' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="filter_ended" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>已结束会话</text><text>历史沟通</text></button>
        </view>
        <view class="chat-operation-label inbox-role-label">身份</view>
        <view class="chat-operation-grid">
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatRole === 'all' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="role_all" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>全部身份</text><text>不限制</text></button>
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatRole === 'customer' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="role_customer" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>我的下单</text><text>客户身份</text></button>
          <button class="chat-operation-chip {{chatRole === 'worker' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="role_worker" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>我的接单</text><text>师傅身份</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{hasPlatformChats || chatRole === 'platform_staff'}}" class="chat-operation-chip {{chatRole === 'platform_staff' ? 'selected' : ''}}" data-action="role_platform_staff" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>平台协作</text><text>平台身份</text></button>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view class="chat-operation-group">
        <view class="chat-operation-label">设置与支持</view>
        <view class="chat-operation-list">
          <button class="chat-operation-item" data-action="notifications" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>通知设置</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{canSwitchChatScope}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="scope" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>{{ordersOnly ? '查看测试会话' : '查看普通会话'}}</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{chatEnabled && isLoggedIn}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="governance" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>举报与申诉</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{auditAllowed && chatEnabled}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="audit" catchtap="runInboxMenuAction"><text>全部订单会话</text><text>›</text></button>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  
  <view wx:if="{{checkingLogin}}" class="inbox-placeholder">
    <text class="cuIcon-loading2 cuIconfont-spin placeholder-icon"></text>
    <view class="placeholder-title">正在确认登录状态</view>
  </view>
  <view wx:elif="{{!isLoggedIn}}" class="inbox-placeholder">
    <view class="placeholder-circle"><text class="cuIcon-people"></text></view>
    <view class="placeholder-title">登录后查看消息</view>
    <view class="placeholder-desc">可从“我的”页进入通知与待办</view>
  </view>
  <block wx:else>
    <subscription-health-banner audience="account" active="{{isLoggedIn}}"></subscription-health-banner>
    <view wx:if="{{summaryError}}" class="chat-connection-warning" bindtap="openOrdinaryNotifications" role="button">{{summaryReady ? '通知摘要暂未更新，点击查看通知' : '通知摘要暂不可用，点击查看通知'}}</view>
    <view wx:if="{{chatEnabled && chatStatus === 'unavailable'}}" class="chat-connection-warning">
      <text class="cuIcon-warn"></text> 沟通连接暂不可用，请下拉重试
    </view>
    <view wx:if="{{preferenceError}}" class="chat-connection-warning" role="alert">{
conversation_wxml:
<view class="conversation-page {{keyboardOpen ? 'keyboard-open' : ''}}" style="padding-bottom:{{keyboardHeight}}px">
  <view class="conversation-context chat-page-toolbar conversation-utility-bar">
    <view class="conversation-context-copy chat-toolbar-copy"><view class="conversation-context-sub conversation-context-only">{{orderContext ? orderContext.publicNo : '订单沟通'}}{{!canSend ? ' · 只读' : ''}}</view></view>
    <button wx:if="{{enabled}}" class="chat-icon-button chat-details chat-menu-trigger" bindtap="chatInfo" aria-label="{{showChatMenu ? '收起会话菜单' : '会话设置与操作'}}" aria-expanded="{{showChatMenu}}"><text class="chat-icon chat-icon-tune" aria-hidden="true"></text></button>
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{showChatMenu}}" class="chat-operation-mask" catchtap="closeChatMenu" catchtouchmove="stopMenuTouch">
    <view class="chat-operation-panel conversation-operation-panel" catchtap="stopMenuTouch" aria-label="会话菜单">
      <view class="chat-operation-group">
        <view class="chat-operation-label">会话</view>
        <view class="chat-operation-list">
          <button wx:if="{{isGroup || testSandbox}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="group" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>群成员与邀请</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{canOpenOrder}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="order" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>{{simulation ? '查看测试订单' : '查看订单'}}</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{!simulation && directCalls}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="calls" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>通话记录</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button wx:if="{{simulation}}" class="chat-operation-item" data-action="simulation" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>测试会话说明</text><text>›</text></button>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view wx:if="{{!simulation}}" class="chat-operation-group">
        <view class="chat-operation-label">工具与支持</view>
        <view class="chat-operation-list">
          <button class="chat-operation-item" data-action="storage" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>聊天缓存</text><text>›</text></button>
          <button class="chat-operation-item" data-action="governance" catchtap="runChatMenuAction"><text>举报与申诉</text><text>›</text></button>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{invalid}}" class="conversation-empty"><text class="cuIcon-warn"></text><view>会话编号无效</view></view>
  <view wx:elif="{{!enabled}}" class="conversation-empty"><text class="cuIcon-comment"></text><view>订单聊天已暂停或状态暂未同步</view><view class="muted">可先通过订单详情或通知与待办联系相关人员</view></view>
  <block wx:else>
    <view wx:if="{{status === 'denied'}}" class="conversation-warning">当前无权继续查看此会话，原有内容已清理</view>
    <view wx:elif="{{status === 'unavailable'}}" class="conversation-warning">连接暂不可用，已加载内容可能不是最新<button class="retry-button" bindtap="retryConnection">重新同步</button></view>
    <view wx:if="{{restrictionText}}" class="conversation-warning" role="alert">{{restrictionText}}<button bindtap="openGovernance">查看状态与申诉</button></view>
    <view wx:if="{{notice}}" class="conversation-warning" role="alert">{{notice}}</view>
    <view wx:if="{{status !== 'denied' && (firstUnread || hasReturn || newCount || showJump)}}" class="reading-actions">
      <button wx:if="{{firstUnread}}" bindtap="firstUnread" disabled="{{windowBusy}}">首条未读 · {{unreadLabel}}</button>
      <button wx:if="{{newCount || showJump}}" bindtap="latestMessages" disabled="{{windowBusy}}">{{newCount ? newCount + '条新消息 · ' : ''}}回到底部</button>
      <button wx:if="{{hasReturn}}" bindtap="returnToPosition" disabled="{{windowBusy}}">返回刚才位置</button>
      <button wx:if="{{unreadCount > 0}}" bindtap="readLatest" disabled="{{!readReady || readBusy}}" loading="{{readBusy}}" aria-label="将本次已完成同步的范围标为已读">读至当前最新</button>
    </view>
